title: Find the end of a string
explanation:
A C string ends with a null character. A loop can count
characters until it reaches that marker. The counter here
belongs to the block where it is declared.

question.prompt: Which condition stops at the string terminator?
question.hint: The terminator is the null character. Think about when to keep counting.

options.feedback: Continue until the current character is null.
This only continues when the current character is null.
